title: Measure one containing production region
objective: Determine whether one leaf change reduces the latency of the exact SGLang region that owns its wrapper, dispatch, synchronization, and overlap.
preconditions: Pinned region boundaries and representative context profile
steps: Time the unchanged production region with reference and candidate dispatch
Include quantization, packing, page-table transforms, fallback, launches, and synchronization
Measure eager and graph modes and record adjacent compute/communication overlap

acceptance.pass: The region meets its declared target with no context or mode regression.
acceptance.no_win: Leaf savings are consumed by wrapper work, launches, fallback, or overlap.

stop_rule: Close a boundary-loss result; do not cite the faster device segment as a production win.
origin_evidence: Task06 had a 1.3713x/1.2834x device segment but failed eager, graph, and region promotion.
